params.body:
- The front page is for version 0.8.2: asking the Principal AI by voice, and a section on the desk app in `desktop/` (how to build it, how a person is linked, that it approves nothing).
- The host of the simulation's relay is a build setting, `-PsimHost=<host>`, since a passkey is bound to it and every machine that runs the simulation has its own. The default is unchanged, so an existing build stays the same.

Checked: the `sim` flavour compiles and the generated relay address is the same as before. The full Android test suite was not run.
params.title: The front page for 0.8.2 and the desk app; the simulation's host is a build setting
